name: Areas Wards
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Persist exact cast/object/area source, geometry, origin, plane, selected recipients/exemptions, authorization, stored spell/slot level, trigger ledger and independent expiry. Resolve appearance, moving-area membership, creature crossing, start/end and delayed aftermath under their own rules. Glyph releases its stored eligible spell once and retains movement/dispel endings.

blockers: Existing areas, Alarm and located aftermath are reuse points. Geometry selection or a logged alarm is not every spell effect. Full stored-spell, sensor, permanent ward and dispel-level consumers still require cross-set mapping; no per-spell ID handler.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
